script_text: CANCER ALERT: This pairing looks electric on paper but burns incredibly fast. Water and Fire clash relentlessly. Cancer's Moon-ruled tides either extinguish or fuel Sagittarius's Jupiter fire, creating magnetic tension that never settles. Cancer craves deep emotional nesting in the 4th House while Sagittarius charges through the 9th House chasing distant horizons. The love prediction reveals that your 7th House cusp holds explosive passion only if Jupiter trines your Cancer Moon this transit. Mercury square between these two signs breeds brutal honesty that wounds Cancer's tender 4th House feelings. This leaves Sagittarius confused and defensive. Saturn conjunct your 10th House demands serious career patience this month — one partner may land a major promotion while the other resists routine. Can Saturn truly bind these fire-and-water souls? Secret tip: Cancer must stop testing Sagittarius with silence, because it destroys trust faster than anything. Comment your partner's sign!
